_readme: DeepL glossary source. Committed and version-controlled so the glossaries
are reproducible: scripts/translate.mjs creates a DeepL glossary per
language from this file and uses it on every translation request.
These are the recurring game-domain terms DeepL got wrong when left to
'host' came back as three different words within French alone, and
'score' drifted to 'result'. One term per concept per language.
Glossaries are immutable in DeepL, so editing this file does not mutate
an existing glossary -- the script hashes the entries and creates a
replacement when the hash changes. Glossary IDs are cached in
.deepl-glossaries.json, which is gitignored (IDs are account-scoped and
DeepL supports glossaries for EN->PT but not for PT-BR/PT-PT separately,
so pt-br and pt-pt each get their own EN->PT glossary and the script
picks the right ID per target. That is what keeps rodada/ronda apart.
